title: Normal ChIP H3K9ac Control in Primary Mouse Hepatocytes
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Resuspend 1 × 10⁶ primary mouse hepatocytes in 1 % formaldehyde, incubate 14 min at room temperature, then add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate an additional 1 min to quench fixation.

steps.title: Wash and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, 303410); thereafter scrape the cells from the plates and collect the suspension.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei by Covaris sonication
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a Covaris E220 tube and sonicate for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 %, 200 cycles/burst to lyse cells and isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the isolated chromatin using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and record the amount for each sample.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each sample, add an equal amount of quantified chromatin to 2 µg of the specific antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, 88802); incubate under the conditions recommended for the antibody to allow immunoprecipitation.

steps.title: Quantify immunoprecipitated DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA recovered from the immunoprecipitation using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific) before proceeding to library construction.

steps.title: Prepare and assess sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the immunoprecipitated DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLabs, E7645S); evaluate library quality and quantity with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the validated libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq instrument and perform paired‑end sequencing (150 bp reads).
